how to join?

Well, you've come to the right place! To join the Licky Clique, you must first make a licky. Unfortunately, this is not a drag-and-drop process; you must color in each frame to create a licky. However, there are only nine frames!

Clicking this text will take you to the licky maker.

After creating your licky, please email me or post the link on my site profile! I will update the members page accordingly, and I will get back to you to let you know when you're added! Please put your licky with your cliques/clubs/webrings so that this project may grow.

rules / guidelines

No hateful images

No blank lickies

Pre-made lickies are fine! Please just give me the link to the original creator so credit can be posted along with your name.
